Build me a monumental, fortress-like stone bazaar or palace complex with a stark, dramatic mood, rendered against a black empty background. Enclose the scene with a broad irregular ring of very tall pale sandstone walls, regularly reinforced by square crenellated towers and occasional massive gate-like openings. Inside, cluster roughly a dozen flat-roofed, blocky buildings tightly around narrow passages, small courtyards, terraces, and a compact market area with scattered colorful awnings and stalls. Place a large square domed pavilion slightly apart from the central cluster, linked by elevated platforms and broad paved walkways. Add several slender cylindrical minaret-like towers capped with bright gold onion domes, concentrated around the inner buildings and along the enclosing walls, plus arcaded balconies, parapets, stairways, and smaller rooftop domes. Use pale tiled or stone ground for the few open plazas, while leaving large gaps between structures as featureless black voids. Keep the core dense, layered, and irregular, but surround it with comparatively sparse open space and an ordered defensive perimeter.

Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes — you are not expected to use all of it, but clean collision and
floating numbers are not on their own evidence that the scene is finished.
Take screenshots, look at them, and judge the result against the description.

clauses.text: Build me a monumental, fortress-like stone bazaar or palace complex with a stark, dramatic mood, rendered against a black empty background
Enclose the scene with a broad irregular ring of very tall pale sandstone walls, regularly reinforced by square crenellated towers and occasional massive gate-like openings
Inside, cluster roughly a dozen flat-roofed, blocky buildings tightly around narrow passages, small courtyards, terraces, and a compact market area with scattered colorful awnings and stalls
Place a large square domed pavilion slightly apart from the central cluster, linked by elevated platforms and broad paved walkways

Add several slender cylindrical minaret-like towers capped with bright gold onion domes, concentrated around the inner buildings and along the enclosing walls, plus arcaded balconies, parapets, stairways, and smaller rooftop domes
Use pale tiled or stone ground for the few open plazas, while leaving large gaps between structures as featureless black voids
Keep the core dense, layered, and irregular, but surround it with comparatively sparse open space and an ordered defensive perimeter
